summary.text: Danny Minton, a Democratic medical sales professional raised in Oklahoma, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Texas's 6th Congressional District to Jake Ellzey.
He says he left the Republican Party for the Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia biography, Minton was raised in a working-class family in Oklahoma. He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oklahoma in 1995; his campaign biography says the degree is in zoology and that he completed master's-level work in epidemiology.

He has worked as a sales representative, including in women's healthcare, and his campaign biography describes consultative sales work training physicians and supporting patients with illnesses including breast cancer and Alzheimer's disease.
Minton says he identified as a Republican for years out of loyalty to his roots before switching to the Democratic Party.
He advanced unopposed from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
During the campaign, he emphasized health care, public education and small businesses.
He received 47.8% of the vote to Jake Ellzey's 52.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
